Requires Level 3 
Modifier Type: Spell

Битва.en:
Requires Level 4 
 Mollok jumps to a location causing 
 area-effect damage 
 Left click icon then left click on target area

й завдає пошкоджень по площі

 Nearby allied Trolls gain
+33% damage, +33% armour
and earn experience 50% faster
Passive ability

Пассивная способность
